description: What scripts/run-tests.mjs does not run from test/*.mjs (RR-46). A new Node test needs no entry; add a file here only when it is a helper, fixture or harness, or a check that CI runs in its own step. Files named *-browser*.mjs are browser suites (test/browser-suites.json, scripts/quarantine.mjs) and are skipped by name. RR-53: contractExclude lists the tests the contract suite (pnpm run test:contract, run by core's pull-request tier) leaves out, each with its reason; every other test of the full run is in the contract.

contractExclude.dependency-boundary.mjs: Proves the vendored pptxgenjs does not load image-size (packaging boundary); no core input.
contractExclude.layout-names.mjs: opf#1319: the user-facing layout names the exporter writes (layoutDisplayName) and import by the layout tag, re-checked over every example deck in both body-text modes (80 s); PPTX naming machinery, the examples are only loop input.
contractExclude.rr-104-no-autofit.mjs: opf#1319: the exporter's source and every example export (32 s) carry no normAutofit, spAutoFit or fontScale; an exporter rule, the example decks are only loop input.
contractExclude.slide-object-ids.mjs: opf#1319: unique p:cNvPr ids on every exported slide after the scalar fragments add shapes, over the technical examples (60 s); PPTX drawing-id machinery, the examples are only loop input.
contractExclude.vendor-names.mjs: opf#1319: no exported part names a vendored library and the chart workbooks carry neutral application names, over every example (44 s); PPTX packaging, the examples are only loop input.
contractExclude.zip-bundle-boundary.mjs: Proves browser bundles use the vendored JSZip bundle and never import readable-stream (packaging boundary, RR-20); no core input.
